name: @kaynooo/check-tools
description: check, fix and errs: run a repo's check, typecheck, lint and test steps or its fixers, showing only what failed with each full output saved to a file, and turn tsc, eslint, bun test, vitest, playwright, phpunit, phpstan and php-cs-fixer logs into file:line:col errors.
author: Kaynooo <contact@kaynooo.fr>

scripts.build: $npm_execpath build src/cli.ts src/fix-cli.ts src/errs-cli.ts --target bun --outdir dist
